statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-8926: when curl is asked to use a .netrc file and the URL names a user without a password, curl could pick up and use the password of another user listed for that host in the .netrc file if there is no entry for the named user (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-8926.html). It affects the curl tool and libcurl from 8.11.1 to 8.20.0 and was fixed in curl 8.21.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/4ae1d7cc2643e4773a136395f12bc02fc6867854. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. Every build before 8.21.0-r0 is a curl release in the affected range, and 8.21.0-r0 is the first build of curl 8.21.0, so it is the first fixed build.
